question: Should maintainers require real connect-timeout retry proof before merging this Telegram send retry change, or intentionally accept source-level Undici proof for this narrow code?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but repository policy treats Telegram transport retry changes as proof-sensitive and automation cannot waive the external-PR real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Require connect-timeout proof
options.body: Ask for redacted runtime logs, live output, or an artifact showing an `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` send retry and no duplicate delivery before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge on the Undici source contract and CI, accepting the lack of real transport proof for this small classifier change.

options.title: Fold into broader retry work
options.body: Pause this PR and handle the exact code alongside the broader Telegram send retry boundary discussion.

recommendation.title: Require connect-timeout proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted runtime logs, live output, or an artifact showing an `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` send retry and no duplicate delivery before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to the current strict-send retry boundary and recent Telegram retry tests.
